purpose: On a weekly or daily schedule, check only the saved Slack and Microsoft Teams sources marked for collection, place new material in workspace/inbox/, and tell the user, without ingesting it.

deliverable.name: Collected inbox files, collection state, and a notification
deliverable.path_or_form: workspace/inbox/ files with collection front matter, workspace/.system/collection.yaml and collection-state.yaml
deliverable.note: The fixture is synthetic and contains no client data.

human_baseline.note: The user has no current figure for the weekly time spent checking Slack and Teams and filling the inbox by hand. Record a timed manual check or a dated estimate before any time saving is reported.

golden_reference.note: Graded against explicit state and trajectory contracts, not a human-written file.

expected_skill_invocations_note: Observable in real scheduled runs through grade_trajectory.py.
required_clarifying_questions: Weekly or daily, and the day and time.
required_clarifying_questions_note: Not graded yet; see the setup-conversation-not-graded gap.

inputs: Connector results normalized into the collection payload
outputs: Inbox files with collected_by front matter
A final message and host notification
environment: Real Codex session logs for trajectory grading

success_conditions: Only locations marked for collection, enabled, and covered by a contract are read.
Material at or before a source's cursor is never collected again; a transcript is never collected twice.
Inbox files appear complete or not at all, with collection front matter.
Meeting passcodes and message text never reach the source record or collection state.
A failed source keeps its cursor.
A scheduled run never runs workspace-add, uses a browser, or searches.
trajectory_requirements: Use only contract operations for Slack and Teams.
Never run workspace-add, move inbox files, or write trackers in a scheduled turn.
Never change the schedule from inside a scheduled run.
known_failure_modes: Broad Slack search instead of the saved channel
Falling back to the in-app browser when a connector fails, triggering a screen-recording prompt
A connector reconnect stalling an unattended run
A half-written file picked up by workspace-add
A Teams join link's passcode saved to disk
Collected filenames colliding with files already filed
failure_mode_provenance_note: The first three were observed in the 2026-10-19 Codex spike and the last in the 2026-10-20 end-to-end test; the rest come from the skill's contract.
unknowns: Behavior on hosts other than Codex
